Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.item

Class ItemGenerator

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.item.ItemGenerator
public class ItemGenerator extends Object
Creates random items. Better weapons and armor appear deeper in the Halls, and deeper floors are more likely to hold upgraded equipment.
